purpose: Refine the selected Rune and Swarm directions in turquoise with sculpted volume; preview only

variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a refined large desktop-app emblem for hgs zerus.
The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve its exact recognizable outline, composition, orientation, component layout, cutouts and transparent negative spaces. The user likes this shape and specifically wants it developed, not redesigned.
Change only color and surface rendering: remove ALL violet, purple and magenta. Use a coherent rich TURQUOISE palette: deep teal side faces (#066c69), saturated turquoise broad surfaces (#20bfb3), pale icy mint highlights (#b3fff0). Turn the flat emblem into a beautiful substantial sculpted 3D object, viewed straight-on with an orthographic camera. Shallow real depth, generous smooth bevels, broad gently curved faces, controlled soft studio highlights from the upper left, darker material on recessed and side faces. Premium satin jade/chitin material, confident clean design. Volume should be immediately apparent at 128–256 pixels. No surface grain, scratches, scales, fine ridges, excessive shine or chrome reflections.
Keep the original footprint and roughly the original transparent margins. True RGBA transparency outside the emblem and through its cutouts. Crisp smooth antialiased contours. No rounded-square app tile, no frame, no floor, no background, no cast shadow outside the silhouette, no glow or halo outside the solid emblem, no floating particles or stray pixels, no lettering, no watermark. Output a single square finished icon, not a sheet or mockup.
Specific invariant: retain the exact flowing Z monogram with its two broad hooked arms and sweeping central diagonal. Integrate the former mint diagonal stripe into the same turquoise material as a gently raised central face, so the whole Z feels like one sculpted object. The Z must still be the exact same letterform, not a different font. Use broad bevels to reveal depth without changing the silhouette.

productionBackgroundEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached turquoise 3D desktop-app emblem.
Keep the exact emblem shape, curved geometry, arrangement, material, teal/turquoise colors, bevels, broad highlights and orientation. Do not redesign it.
Change the background and clean the contour for a production app icon: place the existing emblem on a perfectly smooth, opaque, uniform deep GRAPHITE-TEAL background, exact color #142329, covering the ENTIRE square canvas edge to edge. No transparency anywhere. No rounded rectangle drawn inside the image: the operating system will round the full canvas later. No border, no frame, no outer bevel, no cast shadow or spotlight on the background. The background should remain uniformly #142329 right to all four corners.
Completely remove every detached colored speck, green/cyan noise fragment, fuzz, stray pixel, halo or irregular fringe around the emblem and inside its negative spaces; fill those areas with the same solid graphite-teal background. Make the emblem's contours smooth and immaculate. Preserve the sculpted 3D surfaces. Keep a generous even margin of approximately 12% of the canvas around the emblem, optically centered. One square finished application icon only; no text, no added decoration.
